title: A Flexible Demand Model for Complements Using Household Production Theory
authors: Ludovic Stourm; Raghuram Iyengar; Eric T. Bradlow
eligible_reason: Structural demand model for complements based on household production theory, estimated by MCMC on Nielsen Homescan trips, with coupon and package-size counterfactuals. No treatment adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: Master.sh runs MATLAB estimation, DIC, predictions and counterfactuals; data_prep/*.sas builds the empirical data from Kilts Nielsen raw files.
data_files_note: README: Nielsen data under NDA not provided; only the synthetic datasets from the simulation studies plus SAS code to rebuild the empirical data from Kilts files.
data_provenance_note: Empirical data not shipped; shipped .mat files are simulation-study data.
software_notes: MATLAB R2018a, SAS for data preparation.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
